nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Anti-corruption measures|Corporate transparency measures_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How has transparency among explored fashion brands progressed over time, and what has hindered its growth?
nodes.answer: Transparency among explored fashion brands has increased over time, with transparency scores within each area increasing by about 2.0%-points each year. However, progress has been hampered by the COVID-19 pandemic.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Anti-corruption measures|Corporate transparency measures_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How has the transparency of brands regarding governance information improved from 2017 to the present according to recent investigations?
nodes.answer: Brands have been more forthcoming in sharing their headquarters address, contacts of sustainability representatives, and governance responsibilities compared to 2017.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Anti-corruption measures|Corporate transparency measures_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What proportion of brands disclose whether their sustainability reports undergo external audit processes?
nodes.answer: Less than one-third of brands inform stakeholders about the external audit status of their sustainability reports, indicating a significant room for improvement in corporate transparency.
